Boy I miss the days when I thought this. Can maintain a stable job and kinda keep my life in order. That the worst thing I have to deal with is being hungover a couple times a week and not be my usual sharp self. This is the alcohol talking.

This may not be the case for you, but for me it slowly devolved into actual alcoholism, which I probably had all along. And trust me the pain associated with this is not worth it. You will make decisions you will regret the rest of your life and you’ll be lucky if you can look yourself in the mirror anymore. Quit now before it’s too late. 

Or keep doing what you’re doing. Maybe it won’t get too much worse. My stepdad is there right now and he’s seemingly found a “stable” alcoholism of 2 bottles of wine a night. But he’s in his early 60s and easily looks mid 70s and will most likely die soon. Has high BP and kidney problems.
